decisions.statement: A body whose Telnyx signature does not verify is answered 403 and acted on by nothing.
The signed text is read off the request before anything parses that request.
A verified status reaches the handler seat as a message rather than landing quietly.
The body is carried over whole rather than read for fields nothing here has seen.
The message is written through the pages service, the road a pod's write keeps.
Nothing here answers Telnyx with a message.
The message states its own id.

definition: the toll-free verification status Telnyx hands this app
